name: PennCOSYVIO
summary: 室外到室内的手持视觉惯性轨迹，使用标记定位提供传感器位置参考。
summaryEn: Handheld visual-inertial trajectories crossing outdoor and indoor spaces with fiducial-marker localization references.
scale: Approximately 150 m route; seven cameras and three IMUs
scaleZh: 路线约 150 米；七个相机和三个 IMU
organizationsZh: 宾夕法尼亚大学及合作者
licenseZh: 数据集条款需进一步核查
access: Official downloads, calibration and benchmark documentation
accessZh: 官方下载、校准和基准文档
verdict: 室内外跨场景连续运动
wmNote: 连续传感器流与参考轨迹可用于空间演化建模；部分测试真值由基准保留。
wmNoteEn: Sensor streams and reference trajectories support spatial evolution; some test truth is held out.

evidence.statement: Synchronized video/IMU recordings have an indoor-outdoor sensor trajectory and localized ground-truth positions.
